blind.B1: Yes. In vivo exercise study (S5.1-S5.2): 4 weeks of treadmill running, male C57BL/6 mice, young (9 wk) and old (84 wk). All 24 libraries carry the exercise factor: 12 exercise (YE, OE) and 12 control (YC, OC), soleus and gastrocnemius.
blind.B2: S2.3.p1 and S2.4.p1: YE vs YC and OE vs OC, each within SOL and within GAS, n = 3 mice per group (S5.1.p1). Also OC vs YC (aging) and SOL vs GAS, which are not exercise contrasts. Paper DEGs: SOL YE/YC 31, GAS YE/YC 13, SOL OE/OC 20, GAS OE/OC 13.
blind.B3: Yes. Each mouse gives SOL and GAS (S5.3.p1: RNA from SOL and GAS of mice; 'each group comprised three mice and all mice were subjected to RNA sequencing'). The 'mouse' field (group + replicate number, from the sample description N_SOL_YC-1 / N_GAS_YC-1) links the two tissues once each (12 keys, 24/24 samples). Within a tissue each mouse appears once, so no blocking is needed for within-tissue contrasts. The expression check of the key is 'not_supported' (r diff 0.16, p 0.024), so the SOL-GAS link is a label, not proven.
blind.B4: Pairwise: each comparison is a separate independent t-test on the groups compared (S5.6.2.p1: 'an independent t-test was applied to each gene'), per tissue. No joint model.
blind.B5: S5.6.2.p1: 'The statistical threshold for significance was a p-value < 0.05 and fold change >1.5 for DEGs derived from SOL OC/YC, SOL OE/OC, SOL YE/YC, GAS OC/YC, GAS OE/OC, and GAS YE/YC' (raw p, strict inequalities; 2.0 for SOL vs GAS). Counts per B2 (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1).

checks.evidence: Run, with the four exercise contrasts per tissue; matches B1 (S5.1.p1, S2.3, S2.4).
grp YC/YE/OC/OE with 3 samples per tissue (6 over both), matches source_name_ch1 and S5.1.p1 n=3; controls are the same-age sedentary group; no exclusions.
design contrasts: control YC/OC, treatment YE/OE, matching the paper's YE/YC and OE/OC.

Mouse key links SOL and GAS only; each tissue is fitted separately so one sample per mouse per fit, as in the paper (tissues never compared). Both flagged unused columns (source_name_ch1, mouse) are explained in covariance reasoning. Expression check not_supported, so no sensitivity run is needed.

Paper fits each pair alone (t-test); primary run is a joint 12-sample limma per tissue, but the two-group 6-sample sensitivity runs are reported next to it and the deviation is declared (method gate, deviations).
All male, individually housed (S5.1.p1), one platform and instrument; no batch field. Recorded as none in covariance gate.
N_* columns are log2(FPKM+1) quantile-normalized (S5.5.p1), identical sorted columns, group means match; limma as-is on log scale; p-value histogram frac_p_gt_0.9 about 0.12, healthy.

raw p < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.5849625, strict, transcribed as S5.6.2.p1; FDR audit separately. Our counts are 1.5-3x the paper's and no other rule in the packet table fits (padj gives 0-2, p only gives hundreds); the fold-change scale of the paper (possibly linear ratio of group means) is unknown, which is noted in the study caveats.
Same four contrasts, same rule; HANDBACK states counts are 1.5-3x the paper and the method differs (moderated vs ordinary t); does not claim reproduction. HANDBACK lists 'three miss' but names two.
No stop or refusal; analysis completed.

human_items: Open policy: when the paper rule (raw p, FC 1.5) gives 1.5-3x the paper's counts with limma, which count is the headline; recorded as a declared deviation.
summary: 该案例对比与论文一致：SOL 与 GAS 分开拟合，YE/YC 与 OE/OC，每组 n=3，方向正确。小鼠键只连接 SOL 与 GAS，而这两种组织从不互相比较，因此无需区组。阈值（原始 p<0.05 且 FC>1.5）转录无误，方法差异已声明。无阻断或重大问题。
